correction_acknowledgement: Review-v2 incorrectly described the added tests as API-consistent without checking that SourceBackedPackage::write_topology_to_stream consumes self. The v2 OPC test now constructs independent packages from cloned source bytes for the two consuming calls.
execution: No builds, tests, or workloads were run by this review.

findings.detail: write_topology_to_stream takes self by value. The corrected test creates SourceBackedPackage::from_vec(source_bytes.clone()) for the owned output and a separate SourceBackedPackage::from_vec(source_bytes) for the shared output, so no moved-value reuse remains.

The needless drop(part) was removed because PartView is Copy and its borrow ends after the last use; data and package remain explicitly dropped in the order needed to release the managed payload before the budget assertion.

The helper returns crate::Result and maps litchi_opc::OpcError through Error::Package. Owned uses try_replace_part_shared; Managed and OwnedBudgeted use copy_payload followed by try_replace_part. Existing fixture and managed APIs match their declared types.
The earlier review findings remain: fallback copy/check/reserve/Arc ordering, managed lease containment, ordinary source-first XML publication audit, and unchanged calculation-chain handling.

reviewed_delta.semantic_change: Only the OPC equality test was changed in this delta: each output is produced from a separate SourceBackedPackage; no production behavior changed.
